metadata.sampling_design: Stratified scenario allocation with a declared latent-factor Gaussian copula, shared shocks across alternatives, marginal-preserving inverse transforms, and matched independent/correlation-stress counterfactuals.

decision.title: FinTech Credit Strategy Under Stress
decision.domain: Financial analytics, FinTech, risk management, and responsible AI
decision.question: Select a credit-underwriting strategy that balances risk-adjusted return, loss, capital, inclusion, explainability, and operating cost across macroeconomic stress scenarios.
blocking_reasons: evidence is not labeled for operational use
decision.feasibility_basis: one-sided 95% upper confidence bound on simulated constraint-breach frequency

current-rules.label: Current scorecard
current-rules.description: Retain the existing rules-based underwriting scorecard.

machine-learning.label: Automated ML underwriting
machine-learning.description: Use a high-performing nonlinear model with automated approvals.

hybrid-review.label: Explainable model with human review
hybrid-review.description: Use a constrained model and route uncertain or high-impact cases to trained reviewers.

secured-growth.label: Secured-product growth
secured-growth.description: Shift marginal applicants toward secured products while retaining the scorecard.

factors.label: Systemic adverse demand and delivery shock
factors.description: A shared latent shock moves outcome distributions across criteria and alternatives in the adverse direction; signs follow each criterion's value direction.

evidence.type: Synthetic portfolio estimates and expert stress assumptions
evidence.as_of: Synthetic demonstration; no production as-of date
evidence.causal_claim_status: No causal claim; approval and loss estimates are predictive scenario inputs.
limitations: Group metrics are illustrative and do not establish legal compliance.
Profit estimates omit strategic competitor response.
The Gaussian copula and factor loadings are synthetic assumptions; tail dependence may differ in real data and requires domain approval.

decision_notes: A production stress test should model correlated defaults, funding costs, and capital dynamics.
Legal, compliance, and adverse-action review remain mandatory.
